name: Why is professional blood cleanup on walls necessary?

mainEntity.name: Why is professional blood cleanup on walls necessary?

acceptedAnswer.text: Blood cleanup on walls goes beyond surface-level cleaning. Blood can contain biohazards such as bacteria, viruses, and pathogens that pose health risks if not handled correctly. Professionals use specialized equipment, cleaning agents, and disinfection protocols to thoroughly decontaminate affected surfaces, ensuring the area is safe and free from biological contaminants. This protects occupants from potential exposure and prevents future issues like odor or structural damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional blood cleanup on walls is necessary because blood can contain biohazards requiring specialized disinfection to ensure safety and prevent health risks or structural damage.
